text:
olivia: Starting change window for release/789 now. Deploy bot will start canary traffic at 18:00 UTC. Please watch SLO dashboards (p95 latency, error budget, embed-route 5xx). Pin v2.3.1 to prod route /generate. Release notes: https://redwood.releases/release/789

deploy-bot: [automated] kicking off canary traffic for release/789 -> 2% traffic to v2.3.1 at 18:00:03 UTC. Artifact: redwood/inference:2.3.1

matt: Thanks. Quick ask: what's the explicit rollback gate? If p95 > 350ms for 3m or 5xx rate > 0.5% for 2m we pause? We should document the thresholds in thread.

sara: Confirming rollback criteria: p95 > 400ms sustained over 3m OR 5xx% > 0.6% over any 5m window -> pause and triage. Also if error budget burn > 20%/5m escalate to full rollback.

james: Also flag memory oom or kvcache miss spike. If kv miss rate jumps > 8% correlate with p95 before rollback.

deploy-bot: [metric snapshot] at 18:02:15 UTC: canary p95=210ms, 5xx=0.02%, kv_miss=1.1%. continuing.

olivia: Good. Ops runbook link: https://confluence/redwood/deploys/runbook — use the "partial-pin" flow first (route back to stable for 50% of hosts) before full rollback when possible.

oncall-bot: ALERT: 18:06:22 UTC embed-route 5xx spike -> 0.9% over 1m. Triggered channel alert. See logs: /logs?query=release/789

matt: Seeing the alert. I've started a quick trace check. If traces show model timeouts >= 3x baseline we should partial-pin.

sara: I recommend immediately reducing canary to 0.5% and enabling fallback to v2.2.9 for embed-route. Olivia, OK to partial-pin now?

olivia: Do it. matt, can you run the partial-pin command? I'll notify product and CS.

matt: Running:
```
# partial pin route to stable
redwoodctl route update --route /embed --pin-version 2.2.9 --targets 50%
redwoodctl traffic adjust --route /embed --percent 0.5
```

deploy-bot: [actioned] traffic adjusted at 18:09:08 UTC -> canary 0.5%, pinned /embed to 2.2.9 on 50% hosts. Observability: sampling increased.

oncall-bot: ALERT CLEAR: 18:12:42 UTC embed-route 5xx back to 0.07%.

sara: Nice. Keep monitoring for 15m. If anything else flares we'll roll forward or full rollback per runbook.

olivia: Notifying release lead and adding note to release log. Thank you all.

james: Documenting root cause hypothesis: model config mismatch + kv cache pressure. We'll open a ticket with exact repro.

matt: Filed INF-1723: reproduce kv pressure on v2.3.1 with high embed throughput. Assigned to eng-runtime.

olivia: Great. Marking change window closed at 18:25 UTC — moving residual traffic changes to follow-up.
